# CURSED SCROLL SHADOWDARK ZINE VOL. 2: RED SANDS

## THE DJURUM HEX MAP 

::: {#p2}
:::

![The Djurum Hex Map][djurum-hex-map]

### MAP DESCRIPTION

Djurum is a vast, arid region of open desert, rocky hills, mountains, and salt flats. The western portion is largely open ground, with scattered low hills farther south. Mountainous terrain dominates the north and much of the east, where jagged peaks give way to steep escarpments and enclosed valleys. The south-central region is comparatively open, with scattered hills and rocky outcrops. Isolated structures, settlements, ruins, and other landmarks are marked throughout the hexes. No continuous road or river network is depicted.

**Format:** A flat-top hex grid arranged in staggered north–south columns. Columns are numbered west to east, and rows are numbered north to south. A hex identifier combines its column number (in hundreds) with its two-digit row number. For example, 1108 identifies column 11, row 08. Even-numbered columns contain 10 hexes; odd-numbered columns contain 11.

**Scale:** 1 hex = 6 miles.

**Keyed locations:** See The Djurum Hex Key (pg. 33) for descriptions of numbered hex locations.

#### SIGNIFICANT LANDMARKS

**The Gilzai Mountains** stretch across the northern and northeastern portions of the map. Their rugged peaks extend southward into the central region, interspersed with steep-sided valleys and rocky basins.

**The Echoes** lie among the central mountains. This area is distinguished by prominent curved escarpments, canyons, and enclosed, cliff-ringed plateaus.

**The Silent Mountains** rise in the southeast, forming a separate concentration of jagged peaks along the region’s eastern and southern edges.

**The Salt Flats** occupy a broad area in the southwest: a sun-scorched expanse of cracked clay, pale sand, and scattered rocks, with sparse thorny acacia shrubs, hardy grasses, and rare doum palms near seasonal water sources.

#### TERRAIN AND FEATURES BY HEX

**Default terrain:** Desert, unless another terrain type is specified.

**Interpretation:** A hex listed under multiple terrain types contains both features. Keyed location descriptions take precedence over this map-derived classification.

**Canyon:** 604, 704-705, 804, 904-905, 1004-1005, 1103, 1104-1105\*, 1202, 1204, 1303-1304

**Mountain:** 402-404\*, 503-505, 506\*, 601-603, 604†, 605, 701-703, 704\*, 705†, 706, 801-803, 805, 901-903, 904-905†, 906, 1001-1003, 1004-1005†, 1006, 1101-1102, 1103-1104†, 1105-1106, 1201-1202, 1203†, 1205, 1208, 1301-1302, 1303\*, 1304-1305, 1308\*, 1309-1310, 1401-1403, 1404\*, 1407\*, 1408-1410, 1501-1503, 1507\*, 1508-1511, 1601-1602, 1603\*, 1606\*, 1607-1610

**Salt Flat:** 108-111, 207-210, 308-311, 407-410, 510-511, 610

##### LEGEND

\* When appended to a hex or hex range, the feature lies on a hex boundary throughout the specified range.
† Indicates mountains atop a plateau.

## A MINIATURE HEXCRAWL FEATURING THE DJURUM

A vast, shimmering desert where red mountains stand silent watch over windblown valleys and undulating sand dunes. Merchant caravans pick their way between fragile oases that dot the wastes, hoping to miss the path of mountain bandits, a howling sandstorm, or the skyborn death of **The Scourge**. Here, efreet-haunted canyons hide the ancient redoubt of the **Ras-Godai** assassins, and priceless secrets lie buried, waiting for the winds to shift in their favor...

## INTRODUCTION

The second issue of *Cursed Scroll* arrives on a scorching, desert wind!

This time, we explore an undulating sea of sand, where vibrant camel caravans pick their way across moonlike valleys, and far-eyed bandits peer down from their clifftop perches like birds of prey.

These are the lands where the fearsome **Ras-Godai** sorcerers train in hidden canyon monasteries, perfecting the art of dealing unseen death.

Here, the whipping sandstorms scour flesh from bone. And in their aftermath, forgotten places emerge at long last from beneath the endless sand, calling **crawlers** to tempt their fates inside sinister, secret-filled halls.

As ever, the contents of this zine are fully compatible with the ***Shadowdark RPG*** rules. The free Quickstart Set is available for download at [thearcanelibrary.com/pages/shadowdark](https://www.thearcanelibrary.com/pages/shadowdark).

So unfurl this strange, crumbling scroll you found in a dead banditʼs hand and read as far as you dare! Its secrets might haunt you, might curse you, might send you chasing unimaginable treasures and fighting incredible foes. And when the sands run **red** with blood, whose will it be?

As they say in this place of cruelty and myth:

**May the stories they tell of you outnumber all the grains of sand before us!**

-Kelsey Dionne, Oct. 2022
